question: The National Conference on ‘Environment – 2025’, inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu, was held in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Conference on ‘Environment – 2025’** was inaugurated by **President Droupadi Murmu** in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• This conference aimed to address pressing environmental issues and devise strategies to achieve sustainable development by the year **2025**.
 
• It brought together **policy makers, environmentalists, scientists, and industry leaders** to discuss the challenges posed by climate change, pollution, deforestation, and biodiversity loss.
 
• The conference focused on **innovative solutions**, the role of **technology**, and the importance of **community participation** in addressing environmental concerns.
 
• **New Delhi**, as the host city, is a hub for national and international events, symbolizing its status as the political and administrative center of India.
